Bhikudeva
son of Śambhudeva.
-Priyamvadācarita. kāvya. Baroda II. 12738.

Bhikkambhaṭṭasūri
of Manoharakula, son of Kṛṣṇa Paṇḍita, father of Raghunātha Paṇḍita (a. of Cikitsāmañjarī, Bomb. Uni. 195.).

Bhikkhuṇī_Pācitti
Bud. Pāli. sn. of Pācittīya (Pt. II. of the Suttavibhaṅga of the Vinayapiṭaka). Paris Pāli p. 32.
-C. Aṭṭhakathā by Buddhaghoṣa. Colombo D. I. 1747. [Page145b]
See also under Pācittīya.

Bhikkhuṇī_Pātimokkha
Bud. Pāli. also called Bhikṣuṇīpra(ā)timokṣa. code of monastic rules for nuns, from Vinayapiṭaka; rules vary in diff. texts belonging to diff. schools. See Wint. HIL. II. p. 20.
See also under Pātimokkha, Pratimokṣasūtra an. Prātimokṣasūtra.
AMG. p. 146. II. p. 189. AR. p. 43. Br. Mus. Pali p.. 108. 136-37 (8 mss.; inc.). Colombo p. 48. Colombo D. I. 1693. 1756. Fausboll 19-23. 148. Nanjio 1149 (of Mūlasarvāstivādins). 1161.
For Caturvarga(vinaya)bhikṣuṇī-pratimokṣa of Dharmaguptanikāya, see Nanjio 1156. an. for Pañcavarga(vinaya)-bhikṣuṇīpratimokṣa of Mahīśāsakanikāya, see Nanjio 1158.
Pt.. (1) Fragments a. a. Appendix I. in Pratimokṣa sūtras, in Roman script, ed. by L. Finett with French transl. by E. Huber, J. A. Ser. XI. ii. (1913) p.. 548-49. (2) ed. with Bengali intro. & C. by Vidhushekara Bhattacarya, Calcutta, 1917. (3) ed. an. transl. of Tibetan version by S. C. Vidyabhushan, JASB. (NS) XI. p.. 29-139. (4) Bhikṣuṇīpratimokṣa of Sarvāstivādins, Ed.. & comparitive study by E. Waldschmidt, Leipzig, 1926. (6) with Bengali transl. Śivasagara, 1937. (7) Skt. frgs. with a. analysis of their Chinese transl., Berlin Academy of Sciences, No. II. Sanskrit texte aus den Turfan finden. 1959. [Page146a]
For more study on the text, see Chatsumaran Kabil Singh, The Bhikkhuni Patimokha of the six schools, Indian Book Centre, Delhi, 1998.
-transl. by Fahian an. Buddhabhadra in 414 A. D. Nanjio 1150 (of Mahāsaṅghikas).
-transl. by Jinamitra. Sendai 4.

Bhikkhuṇī_Saṃyutta

Bhikkhupātimokkha
Bud. Pāli. also called Bhikṣupra(ā)timokṣasūtra; code of monastic rules for monks, from Vinayapiṭaka; rules vary in diff. texts belonging to diff. schools. See also under Pātimokkha, Pratimokṣasūtra an. Prātimokṣasūtra.
